reserveReview.rationale: On-chain read on 2026-08-20 via the public XPR Network Antelope API (chain_id 384da888112027f0321850a169f737c33e53b388aad48b5adace4bab97f437e0, head block 399093779, head_block_time 2026-08-20T14:16:39.500 UTC): xmd.treasury holds 2,545,934.333239 XUSDC, 100,000.000000 MPD, 0.000085 XPAX, and 0.000002 XPYUSD against an xmd.token stat supply of 2,645,818.860223 XMD (treasury-basket ratio ~1.00004364). Weights are computed against the total measured treasury balance of 2,645,934.333326 basket units: XUSDC 96.220617% and MPD 3.779383%; XPAX and XPYUSD are dust below 0.000000004% each and are documented here rather than allocated as slices. Issuer disclosures (XPR Network help center, metallicus.com, metaldollar.com) describe a USDC, PYUSD, and USDP/XPAX basket with 1:1 mint and redeem; none mention MPD, which the on-chain xmd.treasury tokens whitelist includes at a 2% maxTreasuryPercent cap (contract mpd.token, controlled by the same swapscold 2-of-4 Metallicus multisig, with a pausempd action and no public backing disclosure). XUSDC, XPYUSD, and XPAX are xtokens bridge wrappers whose upstream assets are Circle USDC and Paxos PYUSD/USDP; that wrapping describes the reserve asset's own form, not XMD's claim on Circle, so the XUSDC slice carries depType collateral rather than wrapper. XMD is not a 1:1 serial claim on USDC: it is a proportional claim on the measured two-asset treasury basket. The MPD slice is classified as an untracked exogenous asset; its undisclosed backing is captured in the high risk tier and risk factors, not as an unallocated residual.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: On-chain xmd.treasury token balances read via the XPR Network Antelope API at head block 399093779 (2026-08-20)
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Treasury balances and weights are fully measured on-chain; the upstream bridge reserves backing the xtokens wrappers and any off-chain custody arrangements are not published, and no dated independent attestation exists.
